dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000rcdc](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000rcdc) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 8.981 depth occurred on Sep 23 2025 44km SW of San Juan De Marcona. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -15.7448 longitude -75.2904. It impacted 7349 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
